projects.title: Private MERN stack on AWS
projects.summary: Multi-AZ VPC with a private Docker host behind an ALB.
bullets: Designed a multi-AZ VPC with public and private subnets, IGW and NAT
Deployed Docker Compose with NGINX fronting React and Node containers on bridge networks
Secured a private EC2 with no public IP, reached through SSM Session Manager
Configured ALB, ACM TLS and Route 53, with X-Request-ID log correlation
projects.imageAlt: AWS architecture: Route 53, ALB, private EC2 running NGINX, React and Node containers, MongoDB Atlas, CloudWatch

projects.title: CloudWatch alarms and secrets
projects.summary: Logs, metrics and alarms plus parameter-based secrets for the AWS stack.
bullets: Configured CloudWatch logs for NGINX and backend containers
Built alarms on disk, memory and ALB health and latency, notified through SNS
Stored secrets in SSM Parameter Store, loaded by a deployment script
Secured MongoDB Atlas by allow-listing only the NAT gateway IP

projects.title: React on S3 and CloudFront
projects.summary: Static React hosting from a private bucket behind CloudFront.
bullets: Deployed the React build to a private S3 bucket
Secured bucket access with CloudFront origin access control
Configured ACM TLS on the CloudFront distribution
Documented a PM2, NGINX and Let's Encrypt variant for a single host

projects.title: ESXi remote desktop lab
projects.summary: Seven-server RDS and DaaS on bare-metal ESXi 8.0.
bullets: Built ESXi 8.0 on a Hetzner bare-metal server
Deployed seven Windows Server 2022 VMs covering AD, RDS roles and a jumpbox
Configured a dual-NIC RD Gateway on 443 with NAT
Secured the lab with a public vSwitch0 and a private vSwitch1 that has no uplink
projects.imageAlt: ESXi lab diagram: RD Gateway with two NICs, session hosts and domain controller on public and internal vSwitches

projects.title: Domain controller migration lab
projects.summary: Moved AD, DNS and DHCP from DC01 to DC02.
bullets: Migrated all five FSMO roles from DC01 to DC02 with PowerShell
Ran adprep forestprep and domainprep before promoting the new controller
Ran repadmin and dcdiag replication checks before each role move
Migrated DNS and DHCP services to the new server

projects.title: Microservices on EC2 with CI/CD

Documented SSM Parameter Store secrets for RDS and MongoDB Atlas credentials
